name: 1-methyl-DMT
summary: 1-Methyl-DMT, or 1-Me-DMT, also known as 1-methyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as 1,N,N-trimethyltryptamine (1,N,N-TMT or 1-TMT), is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and lespedamine (1-methoxy-DMT).

pharmacology.text: 1-Methyl-DMT appears to have similar affinity for serotonin receptors as DMT, but is more toxic than DMT in rodents. In another study, it showed 3-fold higher affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor than DMT. In a further study, it showed abolished affinity for the 5-HT1E receptor and 30-fold lower affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1F receptor than DMT. 1-Methyl-DMT shows comparable psychoplastogenic effects in preclinical research to DMT.

uses.en: It is used only in research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In rodents it was found to be more toxic than DMT.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在囓齒動物中，它被發現比DMT更具毒性。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在囓齿动物中，它被发现比DMT更具毒性。

fact.en: Its close relative lespedamine, which has a methoxy group where this has a methyl, is a natural alkaloid from the bush clover plant Lespedeza bicolor.
fact.zh: 它的近親lespedamine（在同一位置帶甲氧基而非甲基）是一種天然生物鹼，來自胡枝子（Lespedeza bicolor）。
fact.zhHans: 它的近亲lespedamine（在同一位置带甲氧基而非甲基）是一种天然生物碱，来自胡枝子（Lespedeza bicolor）。
